title: Israeli Artillery and Demolitions Hit Houla, al-Mansouri Overnight
detail: Israeli forces shelled and carried out demolitions overnight into Monday in Houla, al-Mansouri, and Bouyout al-Siyyed, following strikes the previous (Sunday) night on Kfar Remman, al-Mansouri, Zawtar al-Sharqiyeh, Mayfadoun, Arnoun, and Yohmor. No casualties were reported in this round, but the strikes continued the pattern of near-nightly Israeli artillery shelling and house demolitions across south Lebanon border villages.
